support_claim: The packet links billing Helion Robotics Limited to Helion Robotics Ltd via a same-entity name note and names Helion Robotics Ltd as the MSA counterparty, but transitive closure is not licensed and no single grounded excerpt establishes identity between the two referents.

steps.fact: The left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited corresponds to the billed_name Helion Robotics Limited in billing invoices.
Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity.
Contract MSA-HELION-2019 names Helion Robotics Ltd as the counterparty.

The relation contract sets algebra.transitive to false, so identity between the left and right referents cannot be established by chaining the Ltd/Limited equivalence with the contract counterparty linkage.
No packet excerpt directly establishes identity or distinctness between billing:Helion Robotics Limited and contract:MSA-HELION-2019.
